sources.title: GitHub - anadya-s/Satellite-Flood-Detection-UNet: Deep Learning model ...
sources.snippet: A Deep Learning application that detects water bodies and flood zones in satellite imagery using Semantic Segmentation. This project implements a custom U-Net architecture in PyTorch and features an interactive web interface built with Streamlit for real-time inference.

sources.title: Pytorch-UNet-Flood-Segmentation - GitHub
sources.snippet: Pytorch-UNet-Flood-Segmentation This repository contains a PyTorch implementation of a U-Net model for segmenting water areas (flood and permanent water) in Sentinel-1 satellite images. The U-Net architecture is a popular choice for image segmentation tasks, particularly for biomedical and satellite imagery.

sources.title: FloodUnet: A Rapid Spatio-Temporal Prediction Model for Flood Evolution ...
sources.snippet: To address these gaps, here we propose a DL model called FloodUnet to achieve rapid and accurate prediction of flood evolution, based on an enhanced U-Net architecture with a lightweight residual module and channel attention mechanism.

sources.title: Advanced Flood Prediction with Physics-Guided Deep Learning: Combining ...
sources.snippet: The proposed hybrid architecture combines a UNet to capture fine-scale spatial details with a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) to model basin-scale hydraulic interactions, while physics-informed residual losses ensure mass and momentum consistency.

sources.title: [2606.06524] Advanced Flood Prediction with Physics-Guided Deep ...
sources.snippet: Evaluated across diverse floodplain settings, the hybrid model achieves an Intersection over Union of 0.82 and an F1 score of 0.90 for flood extent prediction, outperforming UNet-only and FNO-only baselines. Using hydrodynamic simulations as reference data, the model achieves an RMSE of 0.21 m for water depth and 0.15 m/s for flow velocity.
